decision_time_rule: One frozen pregame decision timestamp per game. Every historical window ends at that exact timestamp, not at game date. Earlier games count only if final by the decision timestamp.

classes.BACKFILLABLE: Both the value and the entity/state it describes are derivable from information already final before decision time, or from fixed facts.
classes.IF_TIMESTAMPED: Requires an archived pregame source timestamp proving the announced player/umpire/weather/roof/doubleheader state was known before decision time. Eventual actual state never substitutes.
classes.IF_RECOMPUTED: Requires recomputation from raw prior data using a method frozen only on information available before the target game; revised vendor historical values are prohibited.
classes.FORWARD_ONLY: Feature directly represents what was known pregame or lacks a trustworthy historical source; historical actual state cannot be backfilled.

rules.pregame_source_validation: Before approving an IF_TIMESTAMPED source, test documented late scratches/changes. A valid archive must preserve the pregame announced state rather than overwrite it with the eventual actual state.
rules.vendor_historical_stats: Treat vendor historical derived stats as revised unless proven otherwise. Recompute from raw event data with methods frozen on earlier seasons.
rules.missing_values: Use identical missing-value handling in backfill and forward paths, including rookies, new parks, unannounced entities, or unavailable forecasts.
rules.unapproved_features: Drop unapproved features from the candidate contract. Never zero-fill a feature that the forward path could later populate with a real value.
